info.title: AssetHub API
info.description: Store files, manage project access and serve authorized content. API paths use /v1, except /healthz and /readyz. Use a scoped project API key for server-to-server integrations; use cookie sessions for the dashboard. Read the API Docs guide for complete authentication, upload and error handling workflows.
